brief:
Palestinians have begun returning to their homes in Hebron following a 10-day Israeli military siege, according to Al Jazeera English. Residents confronted widespread destruction across the city, with significant structural damage and economic losses reported from the operation.

The return comes as families assess the full extent of devastation to their properties and livelihoods. Local authorities have not yet provided comprehensive casualty or damage figures from the siege.
dek: Returning Hebron residents face significant economic and structural devastation after Israeli military operation.
title: Palestinians return to destroyed Hebron homes after Israeli siege
